cases.topology: loopback direct TCP, one gonacos node
host-local TLS/L4 proxy, two Grayling nodes with real PostgreSQL and Redis

knownLimitations: Official Nacos SDK v2.3.5 CancelListenConfig can race an in-flight listen task that restores its local listener. The pinned test calls CancelListenConfig again after quiescence and checks that later publications do not invoke the callback; single-call immediate cancellation is not guaranteed.
Official Nacos SDK v2.3.5 has internal data races under -race; see docs/Nacos原生客户端.md and upstream issues #833/#861. Functional matrix success is not a whole-client race pass.
Production cross-host TLS/network-policy allowed-source and denied-source probes have not been run.
L7 HTTP/2 backend connection multiplexing and other SDK versions/languages are unsupported.
